entries.zh: 干、红、褐、灰、烤、干、烧、干、不育

entries.zh: 潮湿 泥巴 沼泽 沼泽 水淹 滑滑 挤压 粘黏 咕噜

entries.zh: 跌倒 摔倒 爪子 挣扎 沉没

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Enormous cracks in the scorched earth

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Baked ground was as dry as cork underfoot
entries.zh: 烤土干得跟软骨一样干

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Withered, dead leaves and dry twigs

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 古伊粘液 古伊粘液

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Sunk into the lush, green grass

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Nothing grew on the baked earth
entries.zh: 在烘烤的大地上,没有东西长出来

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Wind blew a cloud of dust along the road

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Feet crunched on the withered, dead leaves

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Held her in its squelching, slimy grasp
entries.zh: 抱住她 紧紧握住她

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Slipped and clawed her way through the gooey slime
entries.zh: 滑动和爪子 她的方式通过谷歌黏液

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The snow made a crisp carpet beneath their feet.
entries.zh: 雪在脚下做了一块脆脆的地毯

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: They had entered a fairytale world, where the ground and hills were cloaked in snow.
entries.zh: 他们已经进入了一个童话世界, 地面和山丘都隐蔽在雪中。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Above her, clouds like fluffy cotton balls drifted across the sky and below, autumn’s crisp leaves crunched under her feet.
entries.zh: 在她上面,如松毛棉球飘过天空和下面的云朵,秋天的嫩叶在她的脚下摇摇欲坠。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The land was barren. Nothing grew on the dry, red ground.
entries.zh: 这片土地贫瘠,在干燥的红地上什么都没有生长.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The months without rain had caused enormous cracks to appear in the scorched earth.
entries.zh: 几个月没有下雨 焦土上出现了巨大的裂缝

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The ground was as dry as cork underfoot and her feet crunched on the withered, dead leaves and fallen twigs.
entries.zh: 地面干燥得像软骨脚下,她的脚在枯萎的枯叶和落叶上凸起。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She slipped and clawed her way through the gooey slime.
entries.zh: 她滑倒了,并用爪子 穿过粘液。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The ground was like muddy soup and swallowed her feet in its squelching, slimy grasp.
entries.zh: 地面就像泥汤 吞下她的脚 塞进它粘黏的抓住。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She scrambled up the vertical bank, which was slimy with damp leaves and mud.
entries.zh: 她把垂直的岸上, 湿润的叶子和泥浆粘稠。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The ground was covered in frost and glinted dangerously.
entries.zh: 地面被霜雪覆盖,并危险地闪烁。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The earth was hard with black frost that seeped through his sodden boots and spread ice into every limb.
entries.zh: 地上充满着黑色的霜冻,从他的索登靴子中渗出,将冰层分散到四肢.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Below his feet, the glittering ice cracked and groaned, until finally it split like a lightning bolt.
entries.zh: 在他脚下,闪闪发光的冰裂开并呻吟着,直到最后它像闪电一样裂开.

entries.label: Nouns
entries.zh: 地面、泥土、草、树叶、细枝、苔藓、地衣、霜、冰、雪

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.zh: 木头 草地 古老 被遗忘

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Rough, rutted, pot-holed, bone-shaking, dusty, muddy, slimy
entries.zh: 粗糙 鲁特 陶洞 骨折 灰尘 泥泥 粘土

entries.label: Verbs
entries.zh: 小兰 领队 跟着队 领队 领队 领队

entries.label: Verbs
entries.zh: 受伤 扭曲 转身 卷曲

entries.label: Verbs
entries.zh: 攀登 滴水 跌落 跌落

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Rough path through heather and gorse
entries.zh: 麻烦途经加热器和粗鲁

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Dipped and climbed across the hills

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Climbed steeply up the side of the mountain

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Followed the twists and turns of the river

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Ran between a tunnel of high bushes

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Holes like craters gouged in the surface
entries.zh: 像陨石坑一样的洞穴在地表被挖出

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A grassy path headed down to the left.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The dusty, rugged path wound steeply up the side of the mountain.
entries.zh: 灰尘般崎岖的路径 陡峭地在山的一侧。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The narrow path followed the river and wound through the wood.
entries.zh: 狭窄的路径沿河而行,伤口穿过木头.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The ancient mule track twisted and turned and snaked its way steeply to the top.
entries.zh: 古老的骡子轨迹扭曲了 转弯了 爬到顶端

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The rough track dipped and climbed across the hills through the heather and gorse.
entries.zh: 崎岖的铁轨浸没了,爬过山坡穿过热水炉和粗鲁.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The path suddenly veered to the left and they had a fleeting view of the vivid, blue sea stretching as far as the eye could see.
entries.zh: 这条路突然向左弯曲,他们有一幅浅浅的景象,描绘出生动的,蓝色的海,伸展到眼睛所能看到的地方.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: They followed a rough track between the fields of golden corn, until they came to a stile.
entries.zh: 他们沿着一条粗糙的轨道走在金色玉米的田间,直到他们来到了一块石板上.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Beyond the gate, a flight of narrow, rough steps led down to a stream.
entries.zh: 门外,一条狭窄,粗糙的阶梯飞向溪边.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He searched for a way forward and finally came across what seemed to be a forgotten path, hidden by thorns and creepers and leading deep into the forest.
entries.zh: 他寻找一条前进的道路,终于遇到了一条似乎被遗忘的道路,被棘和爬行者隐藏,并走向森林深处.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The bone-shaking trail was covered in holes like craters, which were filled with mud and water.
entries.zh: 骨震的踪迹覆盖着像陨石坑这样的洞穴,坑内充满了泥土和水.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: They followed the narrow, winding coastal path until they came to a wooden fence. Suddenly, the land fell away in a steep slope and then plunged into the sea.
entries.zh: 他们沿着狭窄的海岸道路行进,直到来到一个木栅栏上,突然,土地在陡峭的山坡上掉落,然后跌入大海.
